object_description: four-storey built enclosure around a green heart with taller emergences on top
design_condition: an ambitious enclosure circumscribes a portion of the territory as a reference space while its emergences dialogue with the built elements to the north, with three gateways keeping the layout permeable

positive: The open square at the centre is immediately appealing despite an austere exterior
A central mineral strip flanked by tree-planted green areas structures the vast square
Residents can make the square their own and generous entrances open the student world to life
An ambitious urban form powerfully responds to the major components of this territory
The figure constitutes a new landmark for the campus, offering two scales of interpretation
The enclosure circumscribes a portion of the territory as a true reference space
The emergences dialogue with the built elements to the north, creating a radiating skyline
Three major gateways create permeability and facilitate fluid relations between the hubs
A new centrality is thus created
Public programmes on the ground floor contribute to the vitality of the green heart
Entrances and vertical links are organised around the heart of the site, providing a focal point
The emergences house apartments taking advantage of different orientations and views
The jury noted the relevance of the design choices made
Foundations, structure, energy and sustainable development have been well understood and addressed
A significant evolution is noted between the first and second stage proposals
negative: Seismic stress absorption problems remain, particularly in the corners
Sliding blinds with fixed vertical slats offer insufficient protection against glare
The project is somewhat penalised economically by its size
The standardised expression of the ensemble and the mechanical representation of the system are not convincing
The overly schematic cut-out of the skyline struggles to add richness and reads as a caricature
The lack of contrast between the enclosure and the crowning elements is detrimental
The images do not reflect the original intentions or the relationship between housing units and core
Standardising interior and exterior expressions impoverishes the solution
The architectural expression does not match the constructive solution described
Although innovative, the housing estate did not completely convince the jury
